findings.what: AC2 requires the delivery to 'distinguish reimbursement, advance application and already settled cases,' and the migration has a dedicated validation arm for already_settled (0206:907-913, asset-only non-control-class payment account). No DB battery cell, runtime World e2e leg, or Playwright cell ever admits/posts an already_settled claim through the real door; the report's own AC2 evidence line misattributes coverage, citing 'World leg 1' when that leg's claim builder is hard-coded to settlement:'reimbursement' (staff-expense-claim-e2e.mjs:270).
findings.evidence: Only pure client/runtime derivation math exercises 'already_settled' (apps/web/lib/work/staff-expense-claim.test.ts:172-210; packages/runtime/tests/staff-expense-claim-unit.test.mjs:195,324) -- never clara.admit_staff_expense_claim_work or clara.wake_record_journal_entry. grep -n "already_settled" packages/db/tests/staff-expense-claim.test.mjs returns nothing. The fixtures module already wires full support (SETTLEMENT.settled, claim()'s paymentAccountCode default at staff-expense-claim-fixtures.mjs:230) but no cell uses it. I independently probed the live rig: admitStaffExpenseClaimWork + wakeRecordJournalEntry with settlement='already_settled' posted correctly (one entry, one committed receipt, one claim row), and a liability-account payment leg was correctly refused CLR10 invalid_claim/constraint:asset -- so the code itself is correct, but this is proven by nothing the ticket ships, and the report's citation of 'World leg 1' as covering it is false.
findings.fix: Add one DB cell (e.g. p638.claim.settled, beside p638.claim.posts) that admits+posts an already_settled claim via admitStaffExpenseClaimWork + wakeRecordJournalEntry and asserts one entry/one committed receipt/one claim row with payable_account_code and advance_id both NULL and payment_account_code set; add one refusal cell asserting a non-asset or control-class payment account is refused (CLR10 invalid_claim, constraint:'asset'). Optionally add an already_settled leg to the runtime World e2e. Correct reports/638-final.md:39 to stop citing 'World leg 1' for this arm.
